book.name: Mareko
book.title: Mareko Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Marekoꞌa Mirihiro

content: Roḡae Modeꞌeteꞌe moneo Ihoziro
Iesuꞌa eꞌe habaꞌa modadu Iudea habaꞌa onamiro ebu hena Ioridana vuḡa moneafa onamiro. Vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa ani vaḡe bare ariro ebu aneꞌa iḡaiḡa haḡainuteꞌe teige ze ihoziro.
Ebu Farisea azaḡa nuꞌa Iesu tuhune nurifine ani vaḡe aradu ḡadiniro, “Ohozeꞌa inuga modogaꞌe idaḡahe?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Moseꞌa nagi goro ḡoeꞌa ziro?”
Zeꞌa niro, “Moseꞌe ohozeꞌa inuga modoꞌidene, aniꞌa ihore soꞌaḡa mirihadu inuga hauꞌeteꞌe enogano inuga modogaꞌe idaḡa rae reiro.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Zamaze riḡa ꞌahine, Moseꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa eꞌe mirihadu ziniro.
Rehano ḡadaheḡano Badiꞌaꞌa ḡau niduꞌa haḡairotene, vaze haḡadu zeꞌe ohoze zu roḡae reiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo ohozeꞌe viꞌa moga modadu inuga teite tiburaꞌuma,
ebu anianine ahiri tiba reꞌuma. ꞌOugadu zeꞌe mene aheu, rehano ahiri tiba.
Eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌa tibuzirotaꞌaꞌe vazeꞌa mene rovoniꞌuma.”
Ze bare ne diuḡirotene, Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa eꞌe moneo ḡadiniro.
Ebu aniꞌa naenaeziro, “Iniuꞌa inuga modadu roḡae ꞌahoga teite hahurine, aniꞌe inuga agirohanadu ubuma ḡezauꞌeteꞌe heuḡa.
Ebu roḡaeꞌa iꞌa modadu ohoze ꞌahoga teite hahurine, aniꞌe ubuma ḡezauꞌeteꞌe heuḡa.”
Iesuꞌa Tahiꞌa Komeꞌakomeꞌa veize Kuraro
Vaze nuꞌa tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa tutuze Iesu vaḡe ariro, mazaḡa Iesuꞌa ꞌevoꞌa zeḡe rana touga uratiro. Rehano ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ze roziro.
Iesuꞌa eꞌe horonirotene, ani zamaḡa ḡuginadu ziro, “Tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa eḡe vaḡe arogaꞌe idaḡa roꞌi zu ago gararoꞌi. Mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa teigeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, iniuꞌa tahiꞌa komeꞌa teige Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe mene mae ḡihinine, aniꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaniꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa mene reꞌuma.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa ane ꞌevore hina ohaziro, ebu ꞌevoꞌa zeḡe rana teadu ze manohuga hidifine kuraro.
Maꞌora Vazeḡa
Iesuꞌa ane ibiḡano ḡadahe onamirotene, vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa ane vaḡe dure aradu Iesu zamao obenaḡa hina tuḡiro ebu ḡadiniro, “Ihore vazeḡa manoḡa, e nougine, ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Ḡa nougadu eꞌe manoḡa rae raꞌohe? Vazeni ꞌahoga zuni mene manoḡa, rehano Badiꞌa ane daꞌo manoḡa.
Ḡaꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌa edeḡa: 'Ago gorugoroꞌi, ubuma ago ḡezanoꞌi, ago ḡonotanoꞌi, vaze moneo ago ḡuriroꞌi, vaze ago soꞌosoꞌozoꞌi ebu viꞌu mogo gubazoꞌi.'”
Aniꞌa Iesu naenaeniro, “Ihore vazeḡa, eꞌe komeꞌanonoꞌo ḡoere ꞌahi niduꞌa hegote ariro.”

Iesuꞌa ani ḡiaḡianadu ani zamare borofiro. Ebu aniꞌa niro, “Ḡa ḡau ꞌahoga ꞌize mene haḡaeha. Onamadu ḡauḡo niduꞌa seronoꞌi ebu zahara azaḡa zenoꞌi. ꞌOugine, ḡa adureo ḡau naeḡa boroboro hidiꞌuma. Ebu aradu eḡe hegotoꞌi.”
Aniꞌa Iesu ḡoere egadu zaguzagaro ebu zamaḡaniꞌa adudu bororuꞌenaꞌa iḡuniro, mazaḡa aniꞌe ufeta maꞌora vazeḡa.
Iesuꞌa ehamu varahiro ebu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziro, “Maꞌora azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa rougaꞌe riḡa bagaḡa.”
Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe Iesu ḡoere egadu zaguzagaro. Ebu Iesuꞌa bare ziro, “Eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa, vazeꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa rougaꞌe riḡa bagaḡa.
Kameroꞌa niduru hoꞌoga diuḡogaꞌe riḡa. Rehano maꞌora vazeḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaniꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa rougaꞌe ufeta riḡa.”
Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe ufeta hune zaguzagaro ebu zeḡeꞌa bare ḡadimutitiro, “ꞌOugine, iniuꞌa ḡabone hidiꞌuma?”
Iesuꞌa ḡiazadu ziro, “Vaze aneꞌa bare ḡabone hidogaꞌe mene idaḡa, rehano Badiꞌaꞌe idaḡa. Badiꞌaꞌa ḡau niduꞌa haḡaogaꞌe idaḡa.”
Ebu Peteroꞌa niro, “Eme emeḡe ḡau niduꞌa modadu ḡa hegotiro.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, iniuꞌa eḡe zu hari manoḡa veize neḡa, negoḡa, ezeḡa, viꞌa, moga, tahiꞌaḡa ga mebaḡa modine,
aniꞌe izidi madaḡano aduga hidiꞌuma rehano, naeḡa ḡae 100 hidiꞌuma—neḡa, negoḡa, ezeḡa, viꞌa, tahiꞌaḡa ebu mebaḡa bare hidiꞌuma. Ebu zama moneo ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma.
Rehano vaze ibiꞌa ḡehaḡaꞌe ḡonaga reꞌuma, u vaze ḡonaga ḡehaḡaꞌe ibiꞌa reꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa Ane Rune moneo Ḡae Uḡiduḡa Ihoziro

Iesu zu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe Ierusalema iteꞌeteꞌea, Iesuꞌa ibitiro ebu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe zaguzagaro zu ani hegotiroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe riharo. Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌa gaubanana aheu fare ane uhiḡa huze aradu naginiꞌa ani mazao fureratiteꞌe ihoziro,
“Emeꞌe Ierusalema iteꞌohe. Ebu Vaze Ubugaꞌe dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ꞌevoreo riꞌiniꞌuma. Ze ani runeo tuḡuniꞌuma zu Iuda mene azaḡa ꞌevoreo riꞌiniꞌuma.
Ebu Iuda mene azaḡaꞌe ḡirihohaꞌuma, ani rana soꞌabidiꞌuma, masiniꞌuma zu goruniꞌuma. Rehano mada uḡidu ḡarugano aneꞌa bare ḡabodi'uma.”
Iakobo ebu Ioaneꞌa Iesu Uminiro
Ebu Zebedeo ubugaubuga, Iakobo zu Ioaneꞌa Iesu vaḡe aradu niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, emeꞌa nagini umideꞌeteꞌe ḡaeꞌa emeḡe veize haḡaoga urateꞌohe.”
Iesuꞌa ḡadiziro, “Zaꞌe eḡeꞌa zae veize nagini haḡaoga urateꞌohe?”
Zeꞌa naenaeniro, “Ḡaeꞌa niḡo mae ḡihiniteꞌe madaḡano emeḡe boꞌaḡano tibaꞌe ḡae edaꞌe mone zu ꞌahogaꞌe ḡae kauri mone iḡuꞌa ḡihiꞌaḡano ehoroga urateꞌohe.”
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Za zaeꞌa nagini umiheꞌetaꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa. Eḡeꞌa gageꞌeteꞌe bioḡa aduga zaeꞌa gagoga idaḡahe, zu eḡeꞌa meiroteꞌe babatisoḡa hina zaeꞌa babatisozoga idaḡahe?”
Zeꞌa naenaeniro, “Oꞌe, eme idaḡa.” Iesuꞌa ziro, “Zaꞌe eḡeꞌa gageꞌeteꞌe bioḡa gagiꞌuma ebu eḡeꞌa meiroteꞌe babatisoḡa meꞌuma.
Rehano eḡe edaꞌe mone zu kauri mone iḡuꞌa ḡihiꞌaḡaꞌe eḡeꞌa mene ziniꞌuma, rehano Badiꞌaꞌa ohoziroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa daꞌo iḡuri eꞌe meꞌuma.”
Iesu tahiꞌa gaubananaꞌa eꞌe igirotene, Iakobo zu Ioane mazao maḡuniro.

ꞌOugadu Iesuꞌa ze huze nuꞌozadu ziro, “Za edeḡa, Badiꞌa aḡuꞌa azaḡa zuhiꞌaziꞌohe rae zamareꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe zeḡe haba azaḡa riḡa zuhiꞌaziꞌohe, ebu gavana vazeḡa boroboroꞌe zeḡe haba azaḡa rana edauꞌohe.
Rehano zaꞌe ze ago teigoꞌi. Zae boꞌaḡano iniuꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune reihi reine, aniꞌe zae tuḡure vazeḡano reꞌuma.
Ebu iniuꞌe zae boꞌaḡano vaze ibiꞌa reihi reine, aniꞌe vaze niduꞌa tuḡure vazeḡano reꞌuma.
Mazaḡa Vaze Ubugaꞌe vazevazeꞌa ane tuḡure azaḡano rouga radu mene ariro, rehano aniꞌe vaze tuḡure vazeḡano rouga radu ariro. Ebu vaze ḡehaḡa veize ane ḡabone hina dibuꞌifine ariro.”
Ubuma Kuruḡa Vazeḡa, Batamio Fainiro
Ebu hena ze Ieriko ariro. Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa zu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa teite Ieriko mode iḡunirotene, ubuma kuruḡa vazeḡa ꞌahoga, Timeo ubuga Batamioꞌa ibi genaḡano hadi umineꞌenaꞌa, ehore radiro.
Ani Nazareta vazeḡa Iesuꞌa vitauꞌeteꞌe igirotene, ḡihau huaro, “Iesu, Davida mariga, eḡe vetuḡahoꞌi!”
ꞌOugirotene, vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa ani roniro, “Ḡa sifu radoꞌi!” Rehano ani ufeta ḡihau huaro, “Davida mariga, eḡe vetuḡahoꞌi!”
Ebu Iesuꞌa tue edanadu ziro, “Ani hunoꞌi.” Ebu ze ubuma kuruḡa vazeḡa hunadu niro, “Inaroꞌi zu edau iḡunoꞌi. Iesuꞌa ḡa huḡadeꞌohe.”
Ebu aniꞌe ane raga dabuaḡa genaḡano feune modadu rafate iḡuniro ebu Iesu vaḡe onamiro.
Iesuꞌa ḡadiniro, “Ḡa eḡeꞌa ḡae veize nagini haḡaoga urateꞌohe?” Ubuma kuruḡa vazeḡaniꞌa niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, e ehamatihi.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa niro, “Onamoꞌi. Ḡaeꞌa eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌeꞌa ḡae manoꞌeha.” ꞌOugirotene, aniꞌa zogone bare ehamaro ebu ibio Iesu hegotiro.
